Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatic collection, parsing, visualization (HTML), and automatic generation of PNG images of graphs of scheduled/emergency electricity outages in Ukraine.

The project receives data from open web pages of suppliers and stores them in JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. These data are then displayed in a fixed HTML template and converted to PNG images, which are stored in `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data Format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for a week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is", without structure normalization.
- `fact` — actual/emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

※Not yet compatible with Resonite

As far as I know, Neos cannot move between directories like Windows "Explorer". Also, as a developer myself, while saving items to the inventory in-game, the items directly under the inventory had already become about 8 columns. I predicted that continuing to save at this pace would inevitably cause the direct level to become a chaotic mess, so I decided to create this tool. ## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

racheko-lab/blive-monitor.body:
# 📡 Bilibili/Douyin Live Streaming Monitoring + Multi-Channel Push

A lightweight live streaming status monitoring tool that supports Bilibili and Douyin platforms, automatically pushing notifications through multiple channels (Bark / ServerChan / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram) when broadcasting/new content is released.

## ✨ Features

- 🎬 **Multi-Platform Support**: Monitor Bilibili and Douyin live streams simultaneously
- 🔔 **Multi-Channel Push**: Push notifications through Bark / ServerChan / Enterprise WeChat / PushPlus / Telegram when broadcasting/new content is released
- 📊 **Streaming Duration Statistics**: Track streaming duration and last broadcast time
- 📝 **History Log**: Keep the latest 200 status change records
- 🔄 **Merged Push**: Merge into a single notification when multiple broadcasters go live simultaneously
- 📱 **Responsive Page**: Mobile-friendly monitoring page
- 🎵 **New Content Detection**: Support for detecting Douyin new content release (optional)

## 📋 Quick Start

### 1. Configure Monitored Rooms

Edit the `rooms.json` file to add broadcasters to monitor:

```json
[
  {
    "platform": "bilibili",
    "id": "1874913653",
    "name": "峰哥亡命天涯"
  },
  {
    "platform": "douyin",
    "id": "83134194400",
    "name": "27～"
  }
]
```

**Field Description:**
- `platform`: Platform, `bilibili` or `douyin`
- `id`: Live room ID
  - Bilibili: Live room number (the number in the URL, such as `https://live.bilibili.com/1874913653`)
  - Douyin: Live room web_rid (the string in the URL, such as `https://live.douyin.com/83134194400`)
- `name`: Broadcaster name (used for display and push notifications)

### 2. Configure Push Channels (Optional)

Broadcasting / new content notifications support multiple channels, configured via the `BLIVE_CONFIG` environment variable (JSON):

```bash
# Bark (iPhone, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "bark", "url": "https://api.day.app/your KEY", "group": "blive"}}'

# Or Enterprise WeChat group bot (free unlimited, recommended)
export BLIVE_CONFIG='{"push": {"type": "wecom", "webhook": "https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=xxxx"}}'

# Or…
```

v4806/ExplorerDock.description: Move File Explorer window buttons from the Windows 11 taskbar to a persistent floating bar to free up taskbar space
v4806/ExplorerDock.body:
# ExplorerDock

Move window buttons from the Windows taskbar into a floating bar displayed at the top.

When working with multiple windows open, the taskbar gets cluttered with a row of window buttons. ExplorerDock removes these buttons from the taskbar and collects them in a lightweight floating bar that you can click to switch between them.

Demo video: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1UGew6rEWA/

## Features

- Window buttons are removed from the taskbar and displayed and switched in the floating bar instead; new windows automatically appear, closed ones automatically disappear
- Left-click to switch, minimize if already in focus; the currently active window button is highlighted
- Buttons display the window name and path, with icons taken from the actual path
- Dark / Light / Follow system / Fully customizable (color scheme, border width, overall scale, font)
- Takes over Alt+Tab: use more powerful app switching cards
- Floating bar position is draggable and remembered
- Floating bar auto-hides when docked to edge, center mode, lock position
- Floating bar can switch between banner/stacked mode
- Alt+Tab app switching cards can merge windows of programs with the same name

## Installation

Download `ExplorerDock-Setup-x.y.z.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/v4806/ExplorerDock/blob/HEAD/../../releases) and double-click to install (includes .NET runtime, no additional environment needed). Alternatively, download `ExplorerDock-x.y.z-portable.zip` for portable use, but it requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime to be installed on the system.

## First Launch

The first run will pop up a **Setup Wizard** that step-by-step confirms the management scope, floating bar behavior, color scheme, and startup method — each step takes effect immediately so you can see the changes right away. The 'Run as administrator' option is checked by default; unchecking it will show you the consequences. After the wizard completes, you can run through it again anytime from the 'Setup Wizard...' option in the menu.

## Usage

| Operation | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Left-click button | Switch to that window; minimize if already in focus |
| Middle-click button | Close that window |
| Right-click button | Switch / Minimize / Copy path / Close window, etc. |
| Drag floating bar at any position | Move position (will be remembered) |
| Scroll wheel | Horizontal or vertical scrolling when there are too many windows |

Tray icon: double-click to show/hide the floating bar, right-click for all settings.

## Alt+Tab

Windows treats 'buttons on the taskbar' and 'items in Alt+Tab' as the same window list and doesn't allow removing just one: after file explorer buttons are collected in the floating bar, those windows also disappear from the system's Alt+Tab.

So ExplorerDock takes over Alt+Tab — the switching panel that pops up is drawn by this program, and the window list is counted by itself, so those file explorer windows with their taskbar buttons removed are still included.

# Flame Dragon Knights 2 Reverse Engineering and Remake ## Introduction This project uses the legal original version of "Flame Dragon Knights 2: The Legend of the Golden City" as a behavior reference, preserving its data formats, interface, audio, and game mechanics from the DOS era, and establishes an editable and extensible clean-room remake engine using Go/Ebiten. What we are doing is recreating the classic, not trapping players in endless archaeological work. The original campaign remains the baseline for faithful mode; dialogue, events, battles, towns, shops, churches, preparations, teams, and save files gradually move away from hardcoded programs to become data and rules that can later extend new campaigns. The original program and copyrighted assets such as art, text, and music are not included in this repository. Players must provide their own legal original version; this project does not represent the original developers or rights holders. ## Game Introduction "Flame Dragon Knights 2" is one of the representative works of Chinese single-player tactical role-playing games (SRPG) in the 1990s. Players command characters with various professions, equipment, and spells on a grid-based battlefield, and between battles experience story, towns, shops, churches, class changes, preparations, and a continuously growing team. What truly makes it irreplaceable is not just the thirty battles, but the rhythm formed by the battlefield, characters, music, and inter-battle life together. After most battles, the game does not directly jump to the next battle; resupply, trading, resurrection, class change, saving, and deployment are equally part of the campaign. Remaking therefore cannot only restore the battle formula, but must also preserve this player path. ## Development History ### Preserving a Technical Record for Taiwan When reverse-engineering animation data, we found a signature in the original files that was almost buried by time: > AFM — Animation File Manager Version 1.00
> Copyright (C) 1993 Lo Yuan Tsung This animation tool was custom-made by Hantang programmers two years before the game's release. The source code and documentation are no longer available, but the data it designed still works in the game. This project reorganizes the reverse-engineered technology into reproducible documentation, not only for remake purposes, but also to record how the Taiwan team in 1995 completed a large-scale tactical role-playing game under DOS limitations. Full overview: [`How "Flame Dragon Knights 2" Was Made in 1995`](https://github.com/wicanr2/fd2_re/blob/HEAD/docs/knowledge-base/15-how-fd2-was-made-1995.md) ### Chinese Text on DOS DOS itself does not display Chinese for games. The original version comes with bitmap fonts, and the text is not a Big5 string: `FDTXT.DAT` stores a sequence of `uint16` character pattern indices, totaling 1016 strings with approximately 58,000 characters; resource #4 of `FDOTHER.DAT` contains 1824 16×16, 1bpp character patterns. Indices 0–35 are digits and English letters, followed by Chinese characters. | Character Pattern Decoding Research Chart | Dialogue Decoding Research Chart | |---|---| | | | The above two charts are products of original data decoding research, not remake runtime screens. xiadd/tg-wb-trending.body:
## Recommendations ✈️ Airport

https://www.easy2023.com/#/register?code=xUYr0P4Z Personal IPLC airport for personal use, stable usage for 2 years

## Instructions

GitHub Actions automatically fetches Weibo trending searches and archives [website](https://xiadd.github.io/tg-wb-trending/) daily, and sends trending messages to the Telegram channel [Weibo Real-time Trending](https://t.me/weibo_hots) hourly

## Deployment

1. Create a bot at [BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) and obtain the bot's token

2. Create a channel and set the bot as the channel's administrator

3. Obtain the channel's ID, you can use the [GetID](https://t.me/getidsbot) bot to get the channel's ID

4. Set TOKEN and CHANNEL_ID in GitHub project settings

5. Change docs/public/CNAME to your own domain, set GitHub Pages to the gh-pages branch

## Development

1. Create a bot using Telegram BotFather
2. Create a new channel and set the bot as the channel's administrator
3. Set TOKEN in the repository to the Telegram bot's token
